sensor: Uncooled VOx microbolometer FPA, 320x240, 17 um pitch, 8-14 um
features: Radiometric thermal camera for indoor human skin temperature detection
Radiometric accuracy +/-0.5 C after on-site calibration; NETD < 50 mK
Intelligent Video Analytics with gyro/accelerometer calibration
Analog CVBS output (SMB) for field-of-view adjustment
2 alarm inputs, 1 alarm output, RS-232/422/485, audio line in/out
ONVIF Profile S and G, GB/T 28181

frigate.notes: Bosch official RTSP scheme: /?inst=1 main, /?inst=2 sub (per Bosch 'RTSP usage with Bosch Video IP Devices'). Default admin user is 'service' (no factory default password — set one first). ONVIF Profile S/G (T/M on INTEOX). Not individually bench-tested.

home_assistant.notes: Generic ONVIF integration; Bosch CPP cameras are ONVIF Profile S/G compliant. Use the 'service' account.

blue_iris.notes: Bosch — use the ONVIF/RTSP (or 'Bosch') profile; default admin user is 'service'.

release_notes: Specs per official Bosch datasheet (DINION_IP_thermal_90_Data_sheet_enUS_77561426955.pdf, V2 Oct 2020). Fixed thermal QVGA <9 Hz, 19 mm, radiometric. The skin-temperature system functions require the VIDEOJET decoder 7000 (VJD-7513) with thermal analytics plus a firmware licence; on its own the camera does not perform them, and no temperature data is stored on the camera or SD card. Power consumption 5.6 W max on PoE (5.4 W on 12 VDC).
